_readme: Horde Invasion chips, read off the in-game Chip Gallery one tooltip at a time.
Not scraped and not scrapeable: the wiki has no chip pages, so every line here
was captured from a screenshot of the game and typed in. If a number matters to
you, check it in game.
`tier` comes from the tile colour rather than the name -- orange is II, the
rainbow tiles are III. Most chips put the numeral in their name, but the ones
that do not (Lawn Care, Glass Cannon) still sit in a tier, and a few carry a
number that is the effect rather than the tier: Slot Machine 4 is the III of
Slot Machine 3.
`text` is verbatim. `shape` is this project's own grouping, added because the
drafter can only act on some of these: `placement` chips are decided by where
you put things, which is the one question this tool already answers.
Complete: all 49 chips in the gallery were read from the game, none derived.
Every `text` is verbatim from its tooltip.
You are offered chips at random during a run and keep 3, so this is never a
loadout you choose -- it is a decision made under an offer. What influences
which tier you are shown is not known yet, and neither is whether the same chip
can appear at two tiers, so nothing here assumes a chip has one fixed rarity.
`scope` is "self" everywhere the tooltip says "your Tatari", which is nearly
everywhere. The four marked "unknown" carry a `scopeNote` saying why they might
reach a co-op partner too: all four change the battlefield rather than anybody's
units, and the map is shared. Untested -- it is a suspicion, and the app says so
`order` is the chip's place in the gallery, read top-left to bottom-right off
the same screenshots the icons were cut from. The game groups by tier and then
by something it never states, so the order is copied rather than derived.
rather than counting on it.

chips.name: Photosynthesis III
chips.text: Obtain 4 energizers every 5 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Bounty Hunter III
chips.text: Obtain 4 extra energizers for each Zobo you kill within 120 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Slot Machine 4
chips.text: Randomly obtain 4 Tatari from your formation. If you exceed the deployment limit, randomly upgrade a number of your Tatari equal to the amount exceeded.

chips.name: Water Form III
chips.text: Your Water Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Fire Form III
chips.text: Your Fire Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Grass Form III
chips.text: Your Grass Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Rock Form III
chips.text: Your Rock Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Lightning Form III
chips.text: Your Lightning Tatari gain a 40% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Lawn Care
chips.text: Generate 6 single-use lawn mowers at the bottom of the map. Once triggered, mowers kill 5 non-boss Zobos in front, and deal damage equal to 50% of Max HP to bosses and subsequent non-boss Zobos that are hit.
chips.scopeNote: The mowers are generated on the map, and in co-op the map is shared.

chips.name: Equalizer
chips.text: Reset all your deployed Tatari to Lvl 4.

chips.name: Center Spotlight
chips.text: Zobo bosses will only appear in the middle 2 columns.
chips.scopeNote: Changes where Zobo bosses spawn, which is a property of the wave rather than of anybody's units, so it plausibly reaches both players.

chips.name: Roll of Fate III
chips.text: Obtain another chip of the same tier at random, plus 200 energizers immediately.

chips.name: On the Move
chips.text: After being moved, your Tatari gain 20% ATK and ATK Speed for 20 seconds.

chips.name: Count to Five
chips.text: The first time you have 3 Lvl 4 Tatari deployed together, upgrade all of them to Lvl 5.

chips.name: Photosynthesis II
chips.text: Obtain 3 energizers every 5 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Bounty Hunter II
chips.text: Obtain 3 extra energizers for each Zobo you kill within 120 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Slot Machine 3
chips.text: Randomly obtain 3 Tatari from your formation. If you exceed the deployment limit, randomly upgrade a number of your Tatari equal to the amount exceeded.

chips.name: Water Form II
chips.text: Your Water Tatari gain a 30% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Fire Form II

chips.name: Lightning Form II
chips.text: Your Lightning Tatari gain a 30% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Glass Cannon
chips.text: All of your Tatari gain 25% ATK, but lose 10% Max HP.

chips.name: Boss Killer
chips.text: Your Tatari deal 25% more damage to Zobo bosses.

chips.name: The Exile
chips.text: Your Tatari without adjacent allies gain 20% ATK, Max HP, and DEF.

chips.name: Rear Guard
chips.text: Tatari in your 2 back rows gain 30% ATK Speed.

chips.name: Backend Support
chips.text: Your Tatari with only 1 Tatari in front of them gain a 30% DMG Boost.

chips.name: Patch Upgrade
chips.text: Replace all of your deployed Tatari below Lvl 3 with random Tatari from your formation. Replaced Tatari's levels are upgraded by 1.

chips.name: Shuffle
chips.text: Replace all of your deployed Tatari with random Tatari from your formation and immediately obtain 600 energizers.

chips.name: Underdog
chips.text: When your element is countered by the enemy, it is considered as countering the enemy instead.

chips.name: New Recruit
chips.text: Raise your deployment capacity by 1 and immediately obtain 250 energizers.

chips.name: Contract Employee
chips.text: Summon 1 random Tatari from your formation. Your summoned Tatari are fixed at Lvl 3 and will not count toward your deployment limit. They cannot be upgraded nor revived.

chips.name: Roll of Fate II
chips.text: Obtain another chip of the same tier at random, plus 150 energizers immediately.

chips.name: Make Waves
chips.text: River crossing time! Create a river that reduces Zobos' Move Speed by 40% when in it.
chips.scopeNote: A river drawn on the shared map, slowing Zobos rather than buffing anyone.

chips.name: Weakest Link
chips.text: Your Tatari of the element with the fewest units deployed gain 10% ATK, DEF, and ATK Speed.

chips.name: Photosynthesis I
chips.text: Obtain 2 energizers every 5 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Bounty Hunter I
chips.text: Obtain 2 extra energizers for each Zobo you kill within 120 seconds. Your Tatari can be upgraded to Lvl 8.

chips.name: Slot Machine 2
chips.text: Randomly obtain 2 Tatari from your formation. If you exceed the deployment limit, randomly upgrade a number of your Tatari equal to the amount exceeded.

chips.name: AFK
chips.text: Enter mandatory auto-battle mode for 90 seconds and immediately obtain 300 energizers.
chips.scopeNote: "Mandatory" auto-battle, and the tooltip never says mandatory for whom.

chips.text: Recall all of your deployed Tatari and obtain 200 energizers for each.
